Invoice.label: Vendor Invoice
Invoice.description: Standard vendor invoice posting — purchase expense or inventory debit against trade payables credit (401).

401.detail: General trade payable (401) used for a fixed asset invoice — should use FA supplier payable (404). Check Fixed Asset Posting Profile acquisition offset account.

408.detail: Accrual account (408) credited on a matched invoice — invoice posting should clear 408 and credit 401, not create a new 408 balance.

Accrual.label: Receipt Accrual (Uninvoiced)
Accrual.description: Goods receipt without invoice — expense or inventory debited, accrued invoices (408) credited. Reversed when the vendor invoice arrives.

401.detail: Trade payable (401) used for a receipt accrual — uninvoiced receipts must use 408 (fournisseurs: factures non parvenues). The invoice matching process will fail if 408 is not used.

ProductReceipt.label: Product Receipt (GRN)
ProductReceipt.description: Goods receipt note posting — inventory or purchase expenditure debited, interim receipt account credited.
